article.title: Financial warfare
article.excerpt: This sort of account is hard to verify, but here goes: Military sources said [Israeli] warplanes attacked structures in which Hizbullah stores its money; among the targets hit were the four el-Mal (Money house) buildings in Bint Jbeil, Nabatiyeh, Baalbek and the Tyre area.
